segmentation.text: Except when traffic is being controlled by a police officer or a traffic-control signal:
When proper signs have been erected,
at a clearly marked stop line
or, if there is none, before entering the crosswalk on the near side of the intersection
or, if there is none, then at the point nearest the intersection where the driver has a view of approaching traffic on the through highway.
After having stopped or, in the event of a yield sign, slowed or stopped,
to other vehicles which have entered the intersection from such through highway
or which are approaching so closely on such through highway as to constitute an immediate hazard
during the time such driver is moving across or within the intersection.

elements.justification: "traffic": the admitted aggregate DEF-NRS-484A-285::traffic, of which ego is a member. "being controlled by a police officer": a dev.human_direction of role police_officer governing (dev.governs) ego's approach carrier c or the intersection i at ego's entry. "or a traffic-control signal": a dev.traffic_signal head governing c or i that is not inoperative (dev.inoperative) at the entry.
"proper signs": a stop sign (dev.stop_sign) or a yield sign (dev.yield_sign) governing (dev.governs) ego's approach carrier c, whose entrance end is i (st.lane_enters); status read through presence.
"a vehicle": the admitted aggregate DEF-NRS-484A-320::vehicle; "the driver" read through its controlled motion (agency reading).

The referent is the act g4-g7 require on ego's approach c to i, carried in full: under a stop sign (dev.stop_sign), "having stopped" at the governing place (the stop line marking c, st.stop_line and st.entrance_of; else short of the crosswalk marking c, st.crosswalk and rel.occupies false; else outside i at c's entrance end), ego at rest (drv.motion.at_rest, DEF-NRS-484A-255 "complete cessation from movement") with its body within p.stop_point_tolerance of the place (st.region_geometry), side read along c (st.lane_direction, prim.region_offset_along); "in the event of a yield sign" (dev.yield_sign), "slowed or stopped": that halt, or ego within the place's stopping zone having decelerated (drv.motion.decelerating) within the .path window p.yield_slowing_distance behind (kin.path_length); found between the approach start and ego's entry into i, as NRS_484B_257_1_o1 states. "After": the judged observations follow that act.
"the driver": of ego, a vehicle (admitted aggregate DEF-NRS-484A-320::vehicle), read through its controlled motion (agency reading).

"shall yield": granting precedence (DEF-NRS-484A-210 "unless one grants precedence to the other"): ego is at rest (drv.motion.at_rest) or not in conflict with the vehicle it yields to (operationalization of g11).

"other vehicles": road users b other than ego of the admitted aggregate DEF-NRS-484A-320::vehicle. "have entered the intersection": b's footprint overlaps i (rel.occupies) after an entry from a carrier c_b whose entrance end is i (st.lane_enters), read through a past operator. "such through highway" (DEF-NRS-484A-275: "on which vehicular traffic is given the right-of-way, and at the entrances to which vehicular traffic from intersecting highways is required by law to yield"): c_b lies (st.on_way) on a highway (st.highway) on which ego's carrier c does not lie, and no stop sign or yield sign governs c_b (dev.stop_sign, dev.yield_sign, dev.governs): traffic on it is given the right-of-way while ego's entrance yields.

"during the time such driver is moving across or within the intersection": ego's footprint overlaps i (rel.occupies) and ego is not at rest (drv.motion.at_rest does not hold); the duty is judged at those observations.

operationalizations.standard: the right-of-way: DEF-NRS-484A-210 "approaching under such circumstances of direction, speed and proximity as to give rise to the danger of a crash unless one grants precedence to the other"
operationalizations.convention: Traffic-conflict technique: two road users are in conflict where, projected at their current velocities, their centres approach within the time-to-collision horizon and their closest-approach centre distance is below the clearance at which their bodies would touch. Direction, speed and proximity enter by degree through the projected velocities and positions.

operationalizations.standard: approaching so closely on such through highway as to constitute an immediate hazard
operationalizations.convention: Gap acceptance: a vehicle b on a carrier c_b of the through highway whose entrance end is i (st.lane_enters, st.on_way, rel.occupies) is an immediate hazard during ego's crossing where its time to reach the intersection is below the critical headway, read as the ground distance from its body to i (st.region_geometry) at or below its speed (kin.speed) times the critical headway; distance and speed enter by degree.

applicability: Ego is a vehicle (driven: agency reading) that entered an intersection i from a carrier c (st.lane_enters) governed by a stop sign or a yield sign (dev.stop_sign, dev.yield_sign, dev.governs), where at that entry no police officer directed (dev.human_direction role police_officer governing c or i) and no traffic signal head governing c or i was operating (dev.traffic_signal, dev.inoperative); and that made on c, between the approach start and that entry, the act g8 names (under a stop sign a halt at the governing place; under a yield sign alone that halt or a deceleration within p.yield_slowing_distance before the place's stopping zone; drv.motion.at_rest, drv.motion.decelerating, p.rest_speed_tolerance, p.decel_tolerance, p.stop_point_tolerance). Judged at every observation from that entry at which ego overlaps i and is not at rest. Where the history that act's search needs precedes the recording, the applicability is unknown.
obligation: For every vehicle b other than ego that either overlaps i after an entry from a carrier c_b of the through highway (c_b lies on a highway on which c does not lie, and no stop sign or yield sign governs c_b), or occupies such a carrier c_b whose entrance end is i with the ground distance from its body to i (st.region_geometry) at or below its speed (kin.speed) times p.immediate_hazard_time: ego is not in conflict with b, that is not both prim.closest_approach_within(ego, b) with horizon p.conflict_horizon and prim.closest_approach_distance(ego, b) with the same horizon below p.conflict_clearance.

narrowings.why: 'the driver' is read through ego's controlled motion.
'proper' and 'erected' are read through the presence of the stop or yield sign governing ego's approach.

scenarios.name: forbid
scenarios.narrative: A stop sign governs ego's approach c; ego comes to rest at the stop line marking c, then crosses the intersection while vehicle b approaches on the unsigned through highway at a distance from the intersection below its speed times p.immediate_hazard_time; their projected closest approach lies within p.conflict_horizon below p.conflict_clearance while ego is within the intersection.

scenarios.name: permit
scenarios.narrative: Same scene; ego stays at rest at the line until b has passed, then crosses with no projected conflict.

scenarios.name: idle
scenarios.narrative: No stop or yield sign governs ego's approach; ego crosses the intersection.

scenarios.name: blind
scenarios.narrative: Scene of forbid, but the source declares dev.governs absent: whether the stop sign governs ego's approach cannot be read.

scenarios.name: branch_1
scenarios.narrative: As forbid, except that ego's only halt was far upstream of the stop line, outside its stopping zone, and ego did not halt at the line: the act g8 refers to was not made, so this duty does not arise (NRS_484B_257_1_o1 judges the missing halt).

scenarios.name: branch_2
scenarios.narrative: A stop sign governs c; ego stops at the line and crosses with no other road user in the scene.

scenarios.name: branch_3
scenarios.narrative: Only a yield sign governs c; ego decelerates before the line, enters without stopping, and is in projected conflict with vehicle b that had already entered the intersection from the through highway.

param_proposals.name: p.rest_speed_tolerance
param_proposals.convention: Stop-detection noise floor: the speed at or below which a sampled speed counts as no movement, set at the resolution of the speed measurement so that a complete cessation from movement is recognized despite sensor jitter.
param_proposals.source: Naturalistic-driving and simulator stop-detection practice (SHRP 2 event coding; CARLA ground-truth velocity resolution).

param_proposals.name: p.stop_point_tolerance
param_proposals.convention: Stop-point tolerance of the ontology's approach convention: the body-to-mark distance within which a halt counts as made at the mark, and beyond which the road user is outside the stopping zone.
param_proposals.source: MUTCD (2009) Section 3B.16 stop line placement; positioning accuracy of stop-compliance studies.

param_proposals.name: p.decel_tolerance
param_proposals.convention: Longitudinal deceleration below which a sampled acceleration counts as none: above coasting and sensor noise, below deliberate braking.

param_proposals.name: p.yield_slowing_distance
param_proposals.convention: Distance travelled before the stopping zone within which a slowing for a yield sign counts as made for that sign: the braking distance of an urban approach.
param_proposals.source: AASHTO Green Book stopping sight distance at urban approach speeds.

param_proposals.name: p.conflict_horizon
param_proposals.convention: Time-to-collision horizon of the traffic-conflict technique: a projected approach of the centres within this time counts toward the danger of a crash.
param_proposals.source: Hayward (1972) time-to-collision; Hyden (1987) Swedish Traffic Conflict Technique; van der Horst (1990) TTC thresholds.

param_proposals.name: p.conflict_clearance
param_proposals.convention: Centre-to-centre distance at the projected closest approach below which the bodies of two passenger vehicles would touch or nearly touch (about a half-length plus a half-width of a design passenger car).
param_proposals.source: AASHTO Green Book, design vehicle P dimensions.

param_proposals.name: p.immediate_hazard_time
param_proposals.convention: Critical headway of gap acceptance: an approaching vehicle whose time to reach the intersection is below it is too close for a turning or crossing manoeuvre to be completed ahead of it.
param_proposals.source: Highway Capacity Manual, 6th ed., base critical headway for a major-street left turn.
